# Purpose

This problem develops load-path reasoning, shaft torsional stress, torque equilibrium, direct shear in bolts, symbolic design, sensitivity interpretation, and engineering judgment. Award credit for a correct torque load path, solid-shaft torsion derivation, bolt-group equilibrium, average bolt shear stress, symbolic stress matching, practical integer selection, and a recommendation bounded by the model assumptions.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model assumes solid circular shafts, rigid flanges, identical equally spaced bolts, equal tangential load sharing, average direct shear in each bolt, static torque transmission, and no frictional torque transfer from bolt preload. Bearing stress, flange flexure, fatigue, fit, stress concentrations, keys or splines, installation preload, and applicable coupling standards are excluded. The prescribed stress-equality criterion is a MEEN 305 mechanics comparison, not a universal coupling-design standard.
